name: Resources
author: bart
description: CPU / RAM / temp / disk cluster with a detail panel

schema.label: Card frame
schema.description: bracket: machined end caps, no surface. rail: accent bar under the row. chamfer: octagonal cut-corner plate. inset: a well carved into the bar. blade: accent edge left, rounded right. emboss/lens/dome: shaded plate, bead, lozenge. bloom: halo coloured by load. flat: the original bordered rectangle.

schema.label: Lens shoulder (px)
schema.description: Width of the domed edge. Larger reads rounder, smaller reads sharper.

schema.label: Lens highlight (%)
schema.description: Strength of the specular hotspot on the dome.

schema.label: Cell divider
schema.description: hairline: a quiet 1px rule. tick: instrument I-beam with a centre node. Both graphite-only.

schema.label: Cell readout
schema.description: columns: the number plus a mini bar-chart of recent history. meter: the number with a progress rule under it. text: the padded number alone.
